description.zh-CN: 在 RPEN 中导入/编辑/导出 Milthm 自制谱（fmt=2），轨道式。v0.7.11：修复「流速倍率」通道/语义列不生效（Speed(12) 主速线的 FlowSpeed(5) 改为写回 flowRaw；FlowSpeed(5) 主速线写回语义并同步载体；线体/线头/整体不透明度通道同样写回）；预览/导出都会响应。v0.7.10：音符级动画导入提示更准确。v0.7.9：多线编辑事件列含全部普通层语义种类。v0.7.8：导入故事板转文本线/贴图线。v0.7.1：全部文字换随包 ChillRoundF（OFL-1.1）。
description.en-US: Import/edit/export Milthm fan charts (fmt=2) in RPEN. Track-based: each judge line = one Milthm track. v0.7.11: fixes the 流速倍率 (FlowSpeed(5)) channel / semantic column having no effect (Speed(12)-primary lines write flowRaw; FlowSpeed(5)-primary lines write the semantic list and speed carrier; line body/head/whole transparency channels now also sync back); preview and export both respond. v0.7.10: more accurate note-level animation warnings. v0.7.9: multi-line columns cover every normal-layer kind. v0.7.8: imported storyboards become text lines / line textures. v0.7.1: all RPEN text uses the bundled ChillRoundF font (SIL OFL-1.1).

description.zh-CN: 启用时用随模组分发的 ChillRoundF.ttf 覆盖 RPEN 文字：界面/按钮/下拉/输入框等所有 DOM 文本，以及所有用 RPE / RPEGame 字体族的画布文本（时间轴、预览文字、编号等）都会换成这个字体；关闭后恢复 RPEN 自带字体。（ChillRoundF 是第三方 OFL-1.1 字体，不是 PhiEdit 自带字体；许可证与版权声明随包。）
description.en-US: Overrides RPEN text with the bundled ChillRoundF.ttf: all DOM text (buttons, selects, inputs, textareas, kbd, code boxes) and all canvas text that uses the RPE / RPEGame families (timeline, preview text, line numbers). Disable to restore RPEN's own font. (ChillRoundF is a third-party OFL-1.1 font, not PhiEdit's bundled font; license and copyright notice ship with the package.)
